root_idea.summary: The root centers on drawing or extending something lengthwise and on joining an added thing to another.
root_idea.development: From physical stretching and lengthening, the meanings develop toward prolonging, increasing or replenishing, supplying aid or provisions, and the related nouns for extension, measure, ink, and material addition.

senses.definition: To extend, stretch, or spread outward.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used for spreading or extending the earth, shade, or another thing; the basic physical extension may be expressed transitively or through a resulting state.

senses.definition: To stretch one's sight toward something with desire or attention.
senses.usage_conditions: A sight-directed construction with the eye or gaze extended toward an object; this is distinct from merely spreading or lengthening a thing.

senses.definition: To prolong or cause someone to continue in a condition, especially error or punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of extending a person's continuation or exposure to a condition; Quranic examples concern error, delusion, or punishment rather than physical extension.

senses.definition: To increase, replenish, or augment one thing by adding to it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used when a river, sea, or other quantity is fed or augmented by an additional supply; the result is increased abundance or flow.

senses.definition: To provide, furnish, or increase someone’s supply of provisions or resources.
senses.usage_conditions: The added provision may be food, wealth, children, or other resources; the construction commonly takes the supplied person or group and the thing supplied with bi- or an equivalent complement.

senses.definition: To reinforce, aid, or succour with additional support or forces.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of strengthening people with helpers, troops, or other means of support; supplying and military reinforcement are closely related but distinguishable applications.
The noun denotes something brought in addition to what is already present; in the Quran it occurs in the image of an additional supply or extension.
In the Quran, the verbal noun describes an extension or prolonging, including the prolongation of punishment; the adverbial use can convey extensive continuation.
The ordinary noun for the substance used in writing; its root association is with supplying or replenishing the writing instrument.

senses.definition: A period or term of time.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it denotes the appointed or agreed term of a people or covenant; the form in the occurrence is inflected for its possessive construction.

senses.definition: One who supplies, reinforces, or provides additional support.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of Form IV; in the Quran it describes the promised source or agent of reinforcement.
A passive participle describing something made long or extended, including the Quranic description of an extended shade.

senses.definition: Abundant or extensive, especially in wealth.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative resultative use in which what is extended is understood as plentiful or ample; the Quranic context applies it to wealth.

senses.definition: Stretched out or extended, with emphatic extension.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form II passive participle; the Quranic description concerns extended columns or pillars. The supplied Lane Quran discussion describes the associated pillars as tall, while the direct lexical construction denotes their being stretched or extended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lengthen a written letter or its sound value.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical orthographic or recitational use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prolong or strain the voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of chanting or of deliberately prolonged speech, including a threatening voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lengthen a life or defer a term.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of duration, including granting someone respite or postponing a term; this broader classical use is not assigned to the Quranic sight or punishment senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make much advance in traveling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of extension applied to progress through a journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become full or crowded with people and goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a market or similar gathering; the source marks this as a figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put oil or similar fuel into a lamp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive use involving replenishing a lamp.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put ink into an inkpot or supply a pen with ink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes increasing the water or ink in an ink receptacle and supplying a reed pen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or take a single dip of ink with a reed pen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A writing-related use for one measure or dipping of ink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To add manure, earth, dust, or sand to land to improve it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agricultural use of adding productive material to soil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give camels a moistened meal, fodder, or nourishing liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied food may be flour or coarsely ground grain moistened with water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull, strain, or stretch against one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III denotes reciprocal drawing or pulling, including pulling a garment together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prolong, delay, or put someone off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or relational construction concerning the prolongation of time with another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a quantity, subsistence, water body, or other thing ample or full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader classical Form IV use of causing increase or fullness, including rivers and seas, beyond the Quranic supply-of-resources construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To walk with an affected, proud, self-conscious gait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The gait includes an artificial inclination of the body and stretching of the arms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a wound to produce thick purulent matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun for the matter is مُدَّة; the use describes its collecting or emerging from a wound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a plant to become succulent, with sap running through it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used when rain makes a twig or wood soft or supple.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stretched or expanded, or to stretch oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of leather, skins, and similar things, and of a person physically stretching himself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become extended, elongated, or stretched.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII intransitive describes an object or shade extending itself or becoming long.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a time, journey, or life to become prolonged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the Form VIII state to duration and progress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a disease to spread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from physical expansion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the day or morning to advance, rise high, or shine forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when the sun is high and the day has progressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strain oneself to give consent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed figurative use describing effort toward agreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take ink from an inkpot with a reed pen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X use denotes drawing a dip of ink for writing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use of obtaining or drawing a supply of breath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or request aid or succour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The requested aid may be sought generally or from a commander in war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To flee.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare quadriliteral lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extent, reach, or the amount covered by an extension.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the space occupied by the extent of vision and figurative expressions for a large extent or amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The advanced or highest time of day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adverbially of the day or morning when the sun is high.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flow of water or a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized verbal noun with a plural referring to flows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traditional measure of grain or similar dry goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Hijazi measure is described as a quarter of a ṣāʿ and as the amount held by two moderately sized hands; other regional standards are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Balanced, moderate, or conformable to the just mean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an affair or case in a rare lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aid or succour supplied to people in war, including an auxiliary force or provisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote an accession to an army or material supplied to strengthen it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mystic aid imparted by a spiritual wali.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized religious or mystical use reported in the lexical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of drawing, pulling, straining, or stretching.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes one occurrence of the action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost extent, limit, reach, or endpoint of time or place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader use includes an extreme limit, whereas the Quranic form is specifically a period or term of time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick purulent matter collecting in a wound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinguished from the thinner discharge called ṣadīd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An auxiliary soldier.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from the military-support sense of مدد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything added to another thing for its utility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical explanation of the original addition or replenishment sense; the ordinary Quranic noun is the writing-fluid sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A row of trees other than palms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode, manner, fashion, or form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing things made according to one manner or pattern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular game of the Arabs or of children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A source or supply that increases the flow or abundance of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a river or spout whose supply augments another flow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large needle used at the sides of cloth when its manufacture begins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used collectively for the threads forming the warp of a web.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The threads composing the warp of a woven web.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective textile use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drawn, pulled, strained, stretched, or lengthened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic adjective describes something made extended by pulling or drawing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall or long in stature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, body, or stature; the Quranic pillar interpretation in the supplied material is kept with the Quranic derived form rather than treated as this non-Quranic headword alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long-lasting or extended in duration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a long period of residence or continuance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a prosodic meter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: So called because of the extension of its constituent prosodic elements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A drink or moist feed made from water and flour, grain, seeds, or similar material for camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also denote fodder in general in this specialized use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An accession or whatever is added to a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an added quantity of milk and other material that accumulates with what is already present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of milk left in an udder as an addition to what has already collected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural or pastoral application of the accession sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Material support that aids Muslims and increases or strengthens their armies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for people and wealth contributing to a military or communal cause.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The supply feeding a sea or great river.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A hydrological use for an accession or source of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Continuous increase or that by which a thing is extended.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine ending intensifies the sense of ongoing addition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Matter or substance capable of receiving form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional philosophical term for material or materials, with specialized technical distinctions among related terms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The radical substance of a word, namely its root letters collectively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical and lexicographical technical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most tall, high, or long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective, including the tallest in stature and the utmost degree of a quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Higher or louder in voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative use applied to vocal height or loudness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Custom or habit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Salt or very salt water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer specifically to water of saline earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water exuding from the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate hydrological use of the same rare noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place on a rope at which it is drawn, strained, or stretched.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for the point or section receiving the pulling force.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Basic drawing, pulling, and stretching branch.
Quran-attested prolonging, supplying, and aiding branches.
Expressions of great extent or abundance.
Headword marker without a lexical definition.
Single act of pulling or stretching.
Time term and broader extreme extent.
Quranic pillar interpretation linked to the supplied QAC occurrence.
Supply of a sea or river.
Comparative or superlative length and height.
Point on a rope receiving the pull.

cautions: Lane's printed Quran references use historical citation conventions; the artifact relies on the independently supplied QAC locations rather than converting Lane bracketed references.

The distribution of the meanings of مَدَّ and أَمَدَّ between prolonging, adding, and aiding is not absolute in the Classical evidence; the Quranic senses preserve the constructions explicitly supported here.
